components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional on input when the structured
            'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2') fields are supplied instead; the flat form
            stays accepted for backward compatibility. On output this is always the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat address
            when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). When supplied
            non-blank it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned
            normalized (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.). Stored and
            returned normalized; appended to 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); a second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected with 409 Conflict. When true, this flag bypasses
            that household duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). It does not create the household link — the
            householdId is always derived from lastName and postcode. When false or omitted, a second
            owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the honorific 'title' followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the lastName when no title was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time from the raw 'telephone', which stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>', where REGION is the
                region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164)
                telephone concatenated with lastName. Assigned at creation; it
                carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the owner's
                customerCode. Derived at read time from the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the owner's fiscalYear (the financial year of the
                registrationDate). Assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The financial year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar year in
                which it ends, so a registration on or after 1 July falls in the next year's fiscal
                year (e.g. October 2026 -> FY27). Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same
                last name and postcode). It is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized 'lastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name and postcode share
                it automatically. Owners with no postcode belong to no household and carry no value.
              type: string
              example: 3A7F9C2E1B4D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived descriptive key for the owner, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the
                owner's deterministic household id (empty when the owner has no postcode). Duplicate
                detection keys off the householdId: a second owner in an existing household is
                rejected with 409 Conflict unless the request opts in with 'sharesHousehold: true'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3A7F9C2E1B4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) at the
                moment this owner was created, approaching the hard per-city capacity limit of 50.
                Assigned at creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at creation, this owner shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard identity
                duplicate). Such an owner is still created but flagged. Assigned at creation and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points start at 0 and gain 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds 1 elapsed fiscal year. Tenure is counted
                in elapsed fiscal years from the registration date, so a newly created owner (zero
                tenure) never earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation by mapping
                membershipPoints to a band: 0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3,
                and 6 or more is level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, read at read time from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region-and-hash identity). REGION is derived from the postcode
                (preferring the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table:
                Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived at read time from the owner's locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the record. Owners
                flagged deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity
                checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0

  version: '1.0'
servers:

  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

      tags:
        - owners

      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination

      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of 'MR', 'MRS', 'MS' or 'DR'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          pattern: '^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$'
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Optional on input when the structured
            'addressLine1' (and optional 'addressLine2') fields are supplied instead; the flat form
            stays accepted for backward compatibility. On output this is always the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' is present, or the normalized flat address
            when only the flat form was supplied.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). When supplied
            non-blank it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input. Stored and returned
            normalized (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King Street'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, level, etc.). Stored and
            returned normalized; appended to 'addressLine1' to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the owner's city per the
            fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'. Stored and returned when present.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. A household is keyed on (lastName, postcode); a second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected with 409 Conflict. When true, this flag bypasses
            that household duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared household member
            (and is not flagged as a possible duplicate). It does not create the household link — the
            householdId is always derived from lastName and postcode. When false or omitted, a second
            owner in an existing household is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed by the
                owner's id. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: /api/owners/1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the honorific 'title' followed by a
                single space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'), or just the lastName when no title was
                supplied.
              type: string
              example: DR Franklin
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). Derived
                at read time from the raw 'telephone', which stays in E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's single unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' with no separators: REGION is the region code derived from
                the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year (the financial year of the
                registrationDate, named by its ending calendar year), HASH8 is the first eight
                upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized (E.164) telephone
                concatenated with lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation; it carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: NSW271A2B3C4D5
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The financial year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named for the calendar year in
                which it ends, so a registration on or after 1 July falls in the next year's fiscal
                year (e.g. October 2026 -> FY27). Derived at read time.
              type: string
              example: FY27
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners who belong to the same household (same
                last name and postcode). It is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the
                normalized 'lastName|postcode', so owners with the same last name and postcode share
                it automatically. Owners with no postcode belong to no household and carry no value.
              type: string
              example: 3A7F9C2E1B4D
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived descriptive key for the owner, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' where normalizedTelephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and householdId is the
                owner's deterministic household id (empty when the owner has no postcode). Duplicate
                detection keys off the householdId: a second owner in an existing household is
                rejected with 409 Conflict unless the request opts in with 'sharesHousehold: true'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|3A7F9C2E1B4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that already shared this owner's first and last name
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at
                creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether more than 80 owners had already been created for this owner's registration
                date at the moment this owner was created. Assigned at creation and never changed
                afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether this owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive) at the
                moment this owner was created, approaching the hard per-city capacity limit of 50.
                Assigned at creation and never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether, at creation, this owner shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                while carrying a different telephone (a soft match that is not a hard identity
                duplicate). Such an owner is still created but flagged. Assigned at creation and
                never changed afterwards.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation (same last name and
                postcode, different telephone). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, assigned at creation. Points start at 0 and gain 2
                when an email address is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3
                or more members, and 3 when tenure exceeds 1 elapsed fiscal year. Tenure is counted
                in elapsed fiscal years from the registration date, so a newly created owner (zero
                tenure) never earns the tenure points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation by mapping
                membershipPoints to a band: 0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3,
                and 6 or more is level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time as '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: STANDARD_METRO
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region, read at read time from the REGION segment of the owner's
                customerCode (the region-and-hash identity). REGION is derived from the postcode
                (preferring the postcode's region, falling back to the fixed city-to-region table:
                Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived at read time from the owner's locality/region via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region has no mapping.
              type: string
              example: Australia/Sydney
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred contact channel derived at read time from the owner's details:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate' measured against the
                owner's 'registrationDate': 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: ADULT

## What I did

Unified `customerCode` + `membershipNumber` (and the derived `checkDigit`) into a single **`memberId`** formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`. A created owner now gets e.g. `NSW2716E6609E1` (NSW · FY 27 · HASH8 `16E6609E` · Luhn CHK `1`).

**New single source of truth** — `OwnerMemberId.java`:
- `memberId(owner)` = `REGION` (postcode/city) + `FY` (2-digit fiscal year via `OwnerFiscalYear`) + `HASH8` (same SHA-256-over-`normalizedTelephone+lastName`, first 8 upper-hex) + `CHK` (Luhn over the digits of `REGION+FY+HASH8`).
- `deduplicate(...)` — collision handling now applies to the `memberId`.
- `region(memberId)` / `fiscalYearLabel(memberId)` — read the region and FY back out of the id.

**Removed:** `OwnerCustomerCode`, `AssignOwnerCustomerCode`, `AssignOwnerMembershipNumber`, `OwnerCheckDigit`; the `customerCode`/`membershipNumber`/`checkDigit` schema properties (openapi.yml), entity columns + accessors (`Owner.java`), the `member_id` column in all four `schema.sql` dialects, and the `checkDigit` mapper mapping.

**Rewired to reference `memberId`:**
- Pipeline (`owners.POST.yml`): `assignCustomerCode` + `assignMembershipNumber` → single `assignMemberId` step (`AssignOwnerMemberId`).
- `OwnerMapper`: `locality` and `fiscalYear` now read from the `memberId` (with registration-date fallback); `memberId` auto-maps to the DTO.
- `AuditOwnerCreated`: both the human-readable line and the structured `OWNER_CREATED` event now carry `memberId`.
- `OwnerPrimaryIdentifier.of()` returns `memberId` (the designed single change-point), so the owner segment (via `locality`), the fiscal-year value and the audit record all resolve through the unified id.
